verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a general developer API/CLI platform (rippling-docs-8, rippling-docs-43, rippling-gh-1) and separate UI features for comparing pay runs and catching discrepancies (rippling-docs-1, rippling-docs-48), but there is no evidence that a payroll preview endpoint or anomaly-surfacing capability is exposed via API for an autonomous agent to call before human approval — all such review features are described as in-app/human-facing.
